name: – Daniel Freund – After § 13 – Am 13
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section III – Commission and executive agencies and the ninth, tenth and eleventh European Development Funds
part_text: 13 a. Deplores the lack of effective control by the European Commission over the legal status of the NGOs (whether non-profit or otherwise) it finances, and the absence of a ceiling on executive remuneration to distinguish between ‘commercial’ NGOs and genuine solidarity-based NGOs;
